Neko animations for R6, netless included (remove it if you want to use your own, the netless script is above the script credits)

Script also might not work with synapse, tested on krnl and working fine

Execute the script and wait for a while for it to load

Controls:
M1 - Attack
Z - Flying attack
R - Lay down
F - Toggle run
T - Taunt

Credits to Creo for making the script, and whoever made the netless
